target_customer: Frontend developers who turn Figma designs and screenshots into UI code
problem: Converting designs into production UI code is slow; CodeParrot used AI to generate component code from Figma files and screenshots inside VS Code.

founders.name: Royal Jain
prior_employers: An edtech startup acquired by an edtech unicorn (CTO)

founders.name: Vedant Agarwala
founders.background_notes: Per YC page. Spelled Agarwal in one FAQ of the shutdown story.

exit.reason: Founders chose an orderly shutdown after burning the pre-seed, failing to raise a follow-on after demo day and reaching about $1.5K MRR.

competitors.name: Locofy.ai
competitors.what: Singapore low-code platform converting Figma designs to code

technical_complexity.rationale: Design-to-code with LLMs is standard engineering with hard parts around code quality; the final product was a Figma-to-code translator delivered as a VS Code extension.

defensibility.rationale: Several funded rivals (Locofy) existed and larger platforms like Builder.io launched Visual Copilot in Oct 2023; no proprietary data was described.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Builder.io launched Visual Copilot in Oct 2023, within the company's life; the shutdown story cites a crowded AI tools landscape.

market_need_then: Developers had a known pain converting designs to code, and funded rivals existed, but the company only reached about $1.5K MRR at its best.

branding.domain_note: Used codeparrot.ai; an unrelated Hugging Face organization named CodeParrot also exists, which confuses search.

identity.mascot_or_character: Parrot implied by the name; no source describes a mascot
identity.voice_and_tone: Casual, with a lightning emoji in the tagline

branding.community_and_virality: Shutdown coverage by Entrepreneur India, Analytics India Magazine and others, and a founder LinkedIn post.

brand_strength.rationale: Press attention came mostly from the shutdown; the name collides with an unrelated Hugging Face project.

pivots.from: Automated API testing from production traffic
pivots.to: UI code generation, a Figma design-to-code engine
pivots.why: API testing struggled to gain early traction; developers liked the UI generation (dates not given)
Final pivot, which reached about $1.5K MRR (dates not given)

outcome_analysis: CodeParrot spent about a year pivoting from API testing to design-to-code, peaked near $1.5K MRR and burned its roughly $500K pre-seed. It could not raise a follow-on after YC W23 demo day and shut down in July 2025. Failure factors are the pivots without traction, weak revenue and failure to raise, in a crowded design-to-code field.
notes: Round type conflicts: the shutdown story and VCBacked say pre-seed, Entrepreneur says seed, and one aggregator lists only $125K; investors (Y Combinator, Team Ignite Ventures) come from a search snippet of a database. Pivot dates are not given. Competitor Builder.io Visual Copilot (Oct 2023) is mentioned only here because it is later than a few months after the batch. Company website returned HTTP 503.
